==Overview==
The Exarch of Virtue's Rest is an [[Imperial title]] awarded to a citizen of [[Highguard]]. The motion to remodel Virtue's Rest was [[Remodel Virtue's Rest|passed]] by the [[Senate]] in Winter 386YE. The Exarch of Virtue's Rest is responsible for supporting the supply and provision of Highborn armies, and helping to ready the territory of [[Bastion]] for the war against the vallorn. More information on the opportunity to create this title can be found in the '''[[The war of thorns and flowers]]''' wind of fortune.

==Responsibilities==
The Exarch of Virtue's Rest has a responsibility to support the supply and provision of [[Highguard_military_concerns#Imperial_Armies|Highborn armies]] and help ready the territory of [[Bastion]] for the war against the [[vallorn]]. In addition, if Virtue's Rest, or the Highborn who run the hostels, were to be threatened in any way, it would be the responsibility of the Exarch to deal with those threats.

==Powers==
===Virtuous Supply===
The Exarch of Virtue's Rest receives twelve doses of liao each season.

==Appointment==
This title is appointed during the Spring Equinox. The Exarch of Virtue's Rest is appointed by citizens of Highguard who control [[congregation]] [[Resource|personal resources]]. The larger the congregation an individual has, the more votes they can allocate in support to a candidate. The voting is handled by the civil servants in the Bourse. 

Only a Highborn citizen may hold the title. They do not receive a seat on the Bourse. As a title appointed through the Bourse they cannot be [[revocation|revoked]] by the [[Synod]].
